@Bettina Kroll, I couldn't set up the Monday digest. The scheduler refused the job: it needs gateway credentials, and the setup route needs an AI sign-in that isn't working right now. So nothing is scheduled yet, and I haven't posted anything to the channel.

Once the scheduler is reachable, the job would run Mondays at 08:00 Chicago time, starting Monday 19 October. It would post in #coastal-team and cover #coastal-team and #coastal-random, plus open customer items from the Coastal accounts. It would leave out money terms and finance documents, since those belong with the account owner and the deal desk. Someone with admin access should check the gateway's auth settings and the AI sign-in. Then ask me again and I'll set it up.
